description: Keeps the three cut leaves of Richard II locked in the chest.
name: Abel Garnish

description: Found nothing, signed, and said to let the other play be.
name: Edmund Tilney

description: May already have reached Hobbins's bag at the Bell.
name: Gilbert Shakespeare

description: Counted out seven shillings and kept the cut unrestored.
name: John Heminges

description: Carrier at the Bell in Carter Lane where William walks next.
name: Thomas Hobbins

description: Asked, heard the offer, and said afterward that he had never been so slighted.
name: William Shakespeare
